subject: Lead sponsor handoff + EB cadence for close plan
messages:
From: Sofie Hansen <sofie.hansen@acme.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:18:00 +0200
Subject: Aligning exec sponsors + EB timing for evaluation/close

Hi Priya / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the leadership team was pleased with the perf numbers. We want to accelerate the close and make sure execs are aligned so legal & procurement can move fast. Two asks from our side:

1) Can Redwood propose who on your side will pair with our exec sponsors (we have Alicia R. — CRO, and Marcus L. — CTO)?
2) We need an EB (executive briefing) in the next two weeks as part of our MAP and evaluation plan. Proposed windows: week of 7 June or week of 14 June. Prefer mornings CET.

I can loop in procurement (Tom) once we lock the sponsor map and EB date. Also please share a working MAP so we can track owners/deliverables.

Thanks,
Sofie
Sofie Hansen
VP, Strategic Programs | Acme Corporation
attachments: RFP_Appendix_B.pdf (ref)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning exec sponsors + EB timing for evaluation/close

Hi Sofie — great to hear leadership liked the demo.

Quick responses and a proposed next step:

- Sponsor pairing: provisional matches below (open to swaps if you prefer):
  - Alicia R. (CRO) -> Marissa Cole, Head of Customer Success (exec sponsor / commercial lead)
  - Marcus L. (CTO) -> Karthik Iyer, Head of Serving Runtime (technical sponsor)
  - For board/finance alignment we can include Laura Bennett (VP, Strategic Accounts) as a secondary exec.

- EB timing: suggest a 45-minute EB + 30-minute tech deep-dive. Proposed slots (all CET):
  - Tue 9 June, 15:00–16:15 CET
  - Thu 11 June, 09:30–10:45 CET
  - Tue 16 June, 10:00–11:15 CET

- MAP & evaluation plan: attaching a working MAP (MAP_draft_v1.xlsx) that lists milestones, owners, and target close dates. Key deliverables we propose:
  - Technical validation (model perf & latency) — owner: Karthik — due 1 week before EB
  - Security/compliance evidence (SOC2 summary, retention policy) — owner: Priya — due at contract review
  - Commercial signoff (T&Cs/Proof of Value acceptance) — owner: Marissa / Acme procurement — target close by 30 June

Next step: pick a slot and confirm sponsor names. I can send a calendar invite and a concise agenda once confirmed.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
phone: +1 415 555 0123

Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning exec sponsors + EB timing for evaluation/close

Thanks Priya — clear and actionable. Small tweaks from our side:

- Sponsor map adjustment: would prefer to have Laura join the EB as primary business sponsor for finance questions; Marissa will act as commercial champion during contract negotiation. So final mapping: Alicia (CRO) -> Laura (primary), Marissa (commercial) as backup; Marcus (CTO) -> Karthik (primary).

- EB agenda (proposed 45 + 30):
  1) 10–15 min: introductions & deal context (Laura + Sofie)
  2) 10–15 min: product demo focused on latency/cost controls (Karthik)
  3) 10 min: deployment & data controls (Priya/Karthik)
  4) 10–15 min: commercial terms & timeline (Marissa)
  5) Optional 30-min tech breakout for engineers

- Evaluation plan: I added two MAP tasks in the attached sheet:
  - Canary run (small production test) — owner: Acme engineering / Redwood infra — target: week following EB
  - Success criteria doc (pass/fail for PoV) — owner: Acme product — due before canary

I also added a short attendee list in the sheet. Priya — can you send an invite once Sofie confirms a slot?

Cheers,
Marissa
Senior Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

On Mon, May 24, 2027 at 11:05 AM Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Priya: quick note — engineering asks to hold a 30-min pre-brief with Acme tech leads the week before EB to align test plan and dataset sampling.

Agree with everything above. Two practical asks from infra side:
- Please confirm Acme tech leads and a 30-min pre-brief window (I recommend Fri 5 June or Mon 8 June, CET mornings).
- I'll attach a draft EB invite (EB_invite_draft.ics) and a short tech checklist. Can we get SOC2 and the retention policy link ahead of the EB so we can prep answers?

I'll own the technical validation tasks in the MAP and will post estimated test run time once we lock data size.

- Karthik

All — thanks for the fast turnaround. We’ll take Tue 9 June, 15:00–16:15 CET (slot 1). Confirmed Acme attendees: Alicia R. (CRO) and Marcus L. (CTO) as exec sponsors; Tom Wallace will handle procurement.

Action items I’m committing to:
- Send attendee confirmations and internal success criteria doc by 2 June.
- Share Acme tech contacts for the pre-brief by 1 June.
